issues.description: The Ride class exposes the 'name' attribute as public in the solution implementation, while the UML in the problem statement shows attributes as private ( '-' ) and the exercise requires adding public getters for all attributes. Making the field public breaks encapsulation and deviates from the specified UML/design. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected visibility and may cause tests that check attribute visibility to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the 'name' attribute private in Ride (private String name) to match the UML/assignment expectation and rely on the public getter getName() as required. Ensure all class attributes follow the UML visibility (private) and are accessed via the corresponding public getters.
